title: WhoPack
description: A Vanilla+ modpack that adds a few visual additions, building blocks, vanilla faithful textures, and more!
body:
### Description
This modpack is mainly intended to make your vanilla experience more visually interesting while keeping consistant with vanilla minecrafts aesthetics! This pack tries to accomplish this while keeping minecrafts game progression almost entirely identical to vanilla (no major changes to structures, game mechanics, progression, etc.)

You'll find:
- Minor adjustments to worldgen
- GUI changes
- Animation changes
- QoL features
- Controller support
- And more!

### Multiplayer support
This pack can *almost* be used on vanilla servers. There is only one mod that you will have to remove to make it compatible which is Spyglass Astronomy.

Despite it claiming to be a client side mod, when attempting to connect to hypixel it would throw an error. Just a heads up!

Obviously if you'd like to play with this modpack on vanilla servers you will lose some functionality including:
- Worldgen
- Conectible Chains
- Spyglass Astronomy
- Possibly more that I've not tested

### Credits
All credit goes to the original mod and resource pack authors, this is really just a compliation with some minor settings adjusted.

in particular I'd like to credit some of the lesser known additions to this pack:
- Rappenem's Refore by Rappenem
- Shrimp's Immersive Interfaces by Shripsnail

I feel that both of these contribute a lot to the look and feel of this modpack so I would highly recommend supporting both of them if you are able to!

[Rappenem's Parteon](https://www.patreon.com/Rappenem)

[ShrimpSnail's Ko-Fi](https://ko-fi.com/shrimpsnail)

Please support other projects in this pack as well these are just a few standout ones that I really love!
